description:
In Never Lie by Freida McFadden, a snowbound couple trapped in an isolated estate discovers the secret psychiatric audio tapes of Dr. Adrienne Hale. But what begins as an eerie investigation quickly turns into a chilling interrogation of domestic secrets, unreliable narrators, and listener complicity.

In this deep dive, we break down why Never Lie is not just another whodunit, but an unsettling examination of how we consume other people's darkest secrets.
